hens_rule_text: Up to 3 chickens allowed in a recognized residential subdivision on a lot under 1 acre; larger lots are not capped at 3 under this rule.
permit_notes: No permit requirement was found in the code text located; the ordinance sets counts, species bans and setbacks rather than a permit process.
setback_notes: Pens, coops, flight cages or other enclosures must sit at least 10 ft from the nearest property line and at least 50 ft from any residence other than the owner's.
coop_rules: Birds must be confined to the owner's property at all times and may not create a nuisance; owners are liable for damage the birds cause.
zoning_notes: Roosters, geese, guinea fowl, ducks, turkeys and peacocks are banned in recognized residential subdivisions on lots of 2 acres or less. Rule is in Title 14, Chapter 2, Part II (Livestock Raising and Keeping Restricted) of the combined city-parish code.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.
